production_read_only.limits: Dataset bytes verified only. Does not verify official-source correctness, current rights, full coverage, actual calendar rendering or physical iPhone Safari.

repository_data_audit.note: No external refresh or DB writes. No enforced failures is not blanket freshness acceptance. Several provider premiere lists lack upcoming entries.

credential_pattern_scan.scope: Existing high-confidence GitHub token/AWS access ID/private key/credential URL patterns; no credential values printed.
credential_pattern_scan.limitations: Pattern scan only; no proof for arbitrary API keys, unreachable objects or deleted remote refs. Not a complete security audit.

review_inventory.limitations: Closed PR review history is not fully re-audited. No blanket complaint completion.
